world.label: Characters
world.description: A person in the story — someone who acts, speaks, wants, and changes over time.

world.label: Locations
world.description: A place the story happens in — a setting that gathers meaning as events accumulate there.

world.label: Items
world.description: An object the plot turns on — not a prop, but *the* ring, *the* letter, *the* heirloom.

facets.blurb: its condition — poisoned, forged, broken, repaired
a CHANGE in how it is used in the plot — NOT a description of its purpose (that belongs on its page)

world.label: Factions
world.description: An organization or group that acts as one — a house, order, company, or force with its own goals.

facets.blurb: who it is aligned with or against

world.label: Lore
world.description: Background the world declares — history, rules, cosmology. Reference knowledge, not a thing that appears in scenes.

world.label: Information
world.description: A declared piece of information — a secret, a fact, a revelation-in-waiting: what it IS and why it matters. Its movement (who learns it, when) is tracked by an anchored Custody topic.

scene.label: Chapters
scene.description: A chapter — the usual home for a run of scenes.
